description.en: ROH-AP001 is OYMotion's tactile dexterous hand, combining five-finger motion with force and position feedback for adaptive grasping. The current detailed product page specifies six active degrees of freedom and 11 moving joints, with modular finger, joint and wrist components for maintenance. UART, RS485 and CAN support robot integration, and ROS/ROS2 development resources are offered subject to the manufacturer's licensing terms. The official overview and detailed page give different weight and dimensional figures, so those conflicting values are omitted here rather than combined into a single specification.
description.zh: 触觉机器人灵巧手，官方目录标示自重640克、高184毫米，配置点阵触觉感知，提供UART、RS485和CAN接口。

specs.label: Active degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Manual version: V1.0.8; Measurement scope: As specified for this exact model in its current official manual

sources.title: oy-ROH-AP001
sources.quote: ROH-AP001 dexterous hand features 11 movable joints, with 6 built-in motor drivers and motor control circuits, providing 6 active degrees of freedom. Equipped with a built-in PID motor control algorithm, it can simulate various human hand grasping operations. Each finger is fitted with a force sensor, enabling real-time monitoring and control of gripping force. Typical applications include robotic end-effectors, educational and research equipment, and bionic prosthetics, etc. ROH-AP001 dexterous hand with UART, RS485 or CAN physical interface, support SerialCtrl dedicated serial protocol, ModBus-RTU protocol and CAN protocol, can provide ROS / ROS2 platforms for secondary development with SDK
